# Python.org
> The official home of the Python Programming Language, with downloads, documentation, community resources, news, events, jobs, and PSF information.

Python.org is the central hub for CPython releases, official documentation, getting-started materials, community programs, and governance through the Python Software Foundation.

## Getting Started
- [Getting Started](https://www.python.org/about/gettingstarted/): Introductory resources for learning Python, installing it, and writing first programs.
- [About Python](https://www.python.org/about/): Overview of Python’s design, features, history, and ecosystem.
- [Applications](https://www.python.org/about/apps/): Examples of real-world uses for Python across domains and industries.
- [Help](https://www.python.org/about/help/): Official pointers to support channels, FAQs, and community help resources.
- [Beginner's Guide](https://wiki.python.org/moin/BeginnersGuide): Community-maintained guide for new Python users and programmers.
- [Python Brochure](http://brochure.getpython.info/): Introductory brochure explaining Python’s benefits and common use cases.

## Downloads & Releases
- [Downloads](https://www.python.org/downloads/): Main download page for current Python releases and installers.
- [All releases](https://www.python.org/downloads/): Official release listings for supported Python versions.
- [Source code](https://www.python.org/downloads/source/): Source tarballs and release artifacts for CPython.
- [Windows](https://www.python.org/downloads/windows/): Python installers, embeddable packages, and release files for Windows.
- [macOS](https://www.python.org/downloads/macos/): Python installers and release files for macOS systems.
- [Android](https://www.python.org/downloads/android/): Python release resources and packages for Android platforms.
- [Other Platforms](https://www.python.org/download/other/): Download information for additional operating systems and environments.
- [Alternative Implementations](https://www.python.org/download/alternatives): Links to non-CPython Python implementations and related runtimes.

## Documentation
- [Documentation](https://www.python.org/doc/): Portal to official Python documentation, guides, and reference materials.
- [Docs](https://docs.python.org/): Official Python documentation site with tutorials, library reference, and language reference.
- [Python 3 Documentation](https://docs.python.org/3/): Current Python 3 docs covering tutorial, library, and language reference.
- [Tutorial](https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/): Official tutorial for learning core Python concepts and syntax.
- [Library Reference](https://docs.python.org/3/library/): Reference documentation for the Python standard library.
- [Language Reference](https://docs.python.org/3/reference/): Formal reference for Python syntax, semantics, and language rules.
- [Installing Python Modules](https://docs.python.org/3/installing/): Guide to installing and managing third-party Python packages.
- [Audio/Visual Talks](https://www.python.org/doc/av): Collection of Python talks and audio/video learning resources.

## Developers & API Reference
- [Python/C API Reference Manual](https://docs.python.org/3/c-api/): Reference for extending and embedding Python in C and C++.
- [Extending and Embedding](https://docs.python.org/3/extending/): Guide to writing C extensions and embedding the interpreter.
- [Python Setup and Usage](https://docs.python.org/3/using/): Platform-specific guidance for installing and running Python.
- [Distributing Python Modules](https://docs.python.org/3/distributing/): Guidance on packaging and distributing Python libraries.
- [What's New in Python 3](https://docs.python.org/3/whatsnew/): Release-by-release summaries of new language and library features.
- [Python HOWTOs](https://docs.python.org/3/howto/): Task-focused guides for common Python programming topics.
- [FAQs](https://docs.python.org/3/faq/): Frequently asked questions about Python usage and development.

## Community
- [Community](https://www.python.org/community/): Overview of the global Python community and participation resources.
- [Python Software Foundation](https://www.python.org/psf/): Information about the PSF, its mission, and Python governance.
- [Quotes](https://www.python.org/about/quotes/): Testimonials and endorsements from Python users and organizations.
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/): The Python Package Index for publishing and installing Python packages.
- [Help](https://www.python.org/about/help/): Community support entry points for users seeking assistance.
- [Beginner's Guide](https://wiki.python.org/moin/BeginnersGuide): Community learning resources for people new to Python.

## Jobs & Opportunities
- [Jobs](https://www.python.org/jobs/): Python job board with roles across software, data, infrastructure, and research.
- [Submit a Job](https://www.python.org/community/jobs/howto/): Instructions for posting Python-related job openings.
- [Success Stories](https://www.python.org/success-stories/): Case studies showing how organizations use Python in production.

## News & Events
- [Python Insider](https://blog.python.org/): Official Python blog with release announcements and project news.
- [Latest News](https://www.python.org/blogs/): Aggregated news and updates from the Python ecosystem.
- [Upcoming Events](https://www.python.org/events/): Calendar of Python conferences, meetups, and community events.
- [Python Events Archive](https://www.python.org/events/python-events/): Listings of Python-specific events and conferences.
- [User Group Events](https://www.python.org/events/python-user-group/): Community user group meetings and local Python gatherings.

## Language, Governance & Legal
- [License](https://docs.python.org/3/license.html): Python license terms, history, and legal information.
- [History and License](https://docs.python.org/3/license.html): Background on Python’s licensing and development history.
- [PEP Index](https://peps.python.org/): Python Enhancement Proposals defining language changes and standards.
- [Python Developer’s Guide](https://devguide.python.org/): Contributor guide for CPython development workflow and processes.
- [Developer Guide](https://www.python.org/dev/): Entry point to Python core development resources.
- [PSF](https://www.python.org/psf/): Foundation information covering governance, membership, and stewardship.

## Ecosystem & Package Publishing
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/): Official package index for discovering, publishing, and installing Python packages.
- [Installing Python Modules](https://docs.python.org/3/installing/): Official packaging and installation guidance for end users.
- [Distributing Python Modules](https://docs.python.org/3/distributing/): Official guidance for authors publishing Python packages.
- [Package Index User Guide](https://packaging.python.org/): Python packaging documentation for building and publishing distributions.
- [Python Packaging User Guide](https://packaging.python.org/): Best practices for packaging, distribution, and dependency management.
